headline: Applied AI / Forward Deployed Engineer | Full-Stack TypeScript · .NET · Python | LLM Features, MCP, Agent Evals
summary: Applied AI engineer with 9+ years of full-stack experience across enterprise, healthcare and e-commerce platforms (TypeScript, Angular/React, .NET/Node). I ship LLM features and AI-agent tooling to production — MCP tools, structured outputs, context engineering and agent evals — and work directly with customers, taking vague problems to production fixes. Before engineering I worked in B2B sales — closing large deals and leading negotiations — so discussing scope, cost and value with customers comes naturally.

experience.context: B2B · Large Angular/TypeScript low-code platform (Nx monorepo, ~20 repositories, C#/.NET)

groups.name: AI & agent tooling
items: Built MCP tools for an open-source agent integration with the platform, incl. a deterministic nested-filter builder with schema validation that rejects invalid configurations before save; 23 merged PRs to the public clio, clio-knowledge and creatio-ai-app-development-toolkit repositories (as of Nov 2026).

Replaced the agent's overloaded always-on instructions with a thin router and on-demand guidance via tool descriptions and versioned bundles — cut persistent context ~75% and fit it under the client's truncation limit.
Extended the agent eval suite with end-to-end scenarios that verify the produced result in a real browser (Playwright), with tool whitelists and negative cases.
Delivered LLM-driven generation of analytics widgets in chat (5 widget types): JSON-Schema structured output, response-to-config converters, prompt engineering.

Hardened LLM response handling in the product AI chat with deterministic post-processing and explicit errors — eliminated one defect class (backported to a supported release) and diagnosed another for the owning team.

Embedded web-client mode running the AI assistant inside an Outlook add-in: built its routing and standalone library (own CI, tests), prototyped cookie-less authentication, co-built fault-tolerant session-token refresh. Add-ins for two host apps run on this mode.
Built an agent-skill orchestrator with ~15 contract tests and a personal agentic workflow (pre-commit root-cause hooks, parallel agent sessions, reusable review/refactoring skills).

groups.name: Customer escalations (L4)
items: Handled ~175 L4 client escalations (2024–2026): reproduced on clean environments, traced to root cause, delivered a fix, workaround or justified closure; median time to close ~1 week.
Untangled multi-layer defects (e.g. two bugs in designer and widget masking each other; a four-step metadata failure chain that froze home pages) and backported fixes to supported release lines.
~40% closed without product changes: separated product defects from configuration, environment and cross-team issues, with evidence for the owning team or clear guidance for the customer.

groups.name: Front-end performance & architecture
items: Led a team refactor splitting the monolithic analytics-widget library into a shared core and 6–7 lazy-loaded modules, removing chart code from the initial bundle (~0.5 MB, ~5% of always-loaded chunks).
Moved a heavy code editor out of the initial bundle into a lazy-loaded library with its own CI, Storybook and tests.
Parallelized web-client startup and added page-load telemetry; added a feature-flagged module-loading cache; backported background-tab load acceleration to two release lines.
Migrated ~190 UI-library components to a new reuse strategy in ~2 weeks; removed redundant change-detection work and duplicate HTTP calls.

groups.name: Product features
items: Built analytics widgets and settings (metrics, calculated metrics, pivot tables); reduced database load from analytics queries; added pivot-table support and CLI delivery to the dashboard migrator.

Owned technical research for WhatsApp Business template management via Twilio (two UI prototypes, architecture decision record); implemented the template lifecycle in a decoupled module with ~50 unit tests.
Implemented WCAG accessibility (screen-reader announcements, focus management, keyboard indicators) and localization into dozens of languages.
Published the developer SDK npm package with automated dependency-integrity checks; remediated dependency and container-image vulnerabilities.

groups.name: Quality
items: Raised share of commits with tests from 27% to 53% and added ~1K test cases; wrote Playwright E2E specs and ~13 test-framework SDK modules; reviewed ~185 pull requests in 2026.
Built scalable healthcare and e-commerce applications with Angular and AWS.
Coordinated multi-team delivery for medical IoT integrations and online consultation systems.
Migrated legacy automotive systems to Angular with an Nrwl/Nx monorepo; developed healthcare product-management tools with React and Redux.

earlier: Frontend Developer, 2016–2017 (Lanet Network, BuddhaSoft; Angular 2+, HTML/CSS)
education: Master's Degree, Management of Organizations and Administration — Volodymyr Dahl East Ukrainian National University · Professional Software Engineering Retraining (2017)
